blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`

blocks.text:
# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

blocks.text:
# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

_Human doc: [`agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md`](agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md)_

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

blocks.text:
# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

blocks.text:
# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

format md + ic anchors] Q & P & C --> CLI[CLI run: wiki_publisher prompts

no field writes when updateTrackerField false] ```

# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

_Human doc: [`agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md`](agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md)_

| Job | `Teammate` |

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config

blocks.text:
# Wiki Publisher

Generic, tracker- and wiki-agnostic base agent that turns a work item's prepared context into one wiki page: it reads the input bundle (`input/<KEY>/`), writes the page as GitHub-flavored Markdown to `outputs/response.md`, and the post-action syncs it to the wiki (Confluence via the dmtools Markdown sync today) and posts the page link back to the originating ticket on Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.

Consuming repos specialize it through `"parent"` inheritance (merging project skill files onto `params.cliPrompts`) rather than forking the config; the base agent itself contains zero domain rules.

## Parameters

Configured via `customParams` in the agent JSON or the project `.dmtools/config.js`; child configs override per key.

- `contentOutput` — publish routing: `target` (`wiki` — alias of `confluence`), `space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix` (page title becomes `<KEY> <Summary> — <pageTitleSuffix>`), `updateTrackerField` (default `false` here — the wiki target writes no tracker fields), `operationType`, `includeInlineComments`.
- `removeLabel` — SM idempotency label dropped once the agent runs (`sm_wiki_publisher_triggered`).

_Human doc: [`agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md`](agents/docs/agents/wiki_publisher.md)_

## Attributes

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Job | `Teammate` |
| Config | `wiki_publisher.json` |
| ContextId | `wiki_publisher` |
| outputType | `none` |
| skipAIProcessing | `true` |

## Actions

### preJSAction: `requireTicket.js`

_Require Ticket Pre-Action_

- Source: `agents/js/requireTicket.js`
- Parameters (customParams):
  - `adoTextFormat`
  - `customStatuses`
  - `stageFallback`

blocks.text:
### Discovery

#### `discovery.json` — Continuous PM discovery published to Confluence
- **ContextId**: `discovery`
- **Ticket type**: any (project decides via its own SM rule/JQL — not wired into `sm.json` by default, since the triggering status/label is project-specific)
- **Pre-action**: `prepareDiscoveryContext.js` — resolves `discovery.space` / `discovery.parentPageId` from project config and, if a discovery page already exists for this ticket, seeds `outputs/discovery/` directly with its current content so the CLI agent edits in place instead of restarting from a blank folder
- **Post-action**: `publishDiscoveryToConfluence.js` — finds-or-creates the ticket's Confluence page (`<TICKET-KEY> <summary>`) under `discovery.parentPageId`, then syncs `outputs/discovery/` to it via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (an `index.md` becomes the page body, every other `.md` becomes a child page), and posts a Jira comment linking to it
- **Outputs**: `outputs/discovery/index.md` + one `.md` file per discovery mode actually run (see `instructions/discovery/output_rules.md`)
- **Required project config** (`.dmtools/config.js`, this repo stays project-agnostic):
  ```js
  module.exports = {
    discovery: {
      space: 'YOUR_SPACE_KEY',      // Confluence space to publish into
      parentPageId: '123456',       // Confluence page ID each ticket's page nests under
      deleteOrphans: false          // optional — remove child pages no longer in outputs/discovery/
    }
  };
  ```
- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Reporting & watchdog

{"newText":"- **Wiring the trigger**: add a rule via `smRules`/`smMergeRules` in the project's own config (e.g. JQL on a `Discovery` status or label), pointing `configFile` at `agents/discovery.json` — see `AGENTS.md`'s "SM rules override and custom agents" section for the pattern.

### Wiki publishing

#### `wiki_publisher.json` — Generic wiki page publisher (base agent)
- **ContextId**: `wiki_publisher`
- **Ticket type**: any (not wired into `sm.json` by default — consuming repos add their own SM rule and specialize the agent via `"parent"` inheritance)
- **Pre-actions**: `requireTicket.js`, `preCliContentOutputSetup.js` — bundles questions, parent context and the existing wiki page snapshot (Markdown + inline-comment anchors) into `input/<KEY>/`
- **Post-action**: `writeContentOutput.js` — posts inline-comment replies, syncs `outputs/response.md` to the ticket's page via `confluence_sync_markdown_directory` (`contentOutput.target: "wiki"`), and notifies the originating tracker through the tracker-agnostic layer (no tracker-field writes by default)
- **Outputs**: `outputs/response.md` (page body, GFM) + optional `outputs/confluence_replies.json`
- **Specialization**: child config declares `"parent": { "path": ".../wiki_publisher.json", "merge": ["params.cliPrompts"] }` and adds project skill `.md` files; project config routes the page via `customParams.contentOutput` (`space`, `parentPageId`, `pageTitleSuffix`)
- **Wiring the trigger**: same `smRules` pattern as discovery, pointing `configFile` at the child agent config
